verdict.rationale: LocalAI's own docs state that it supports the Anthropic Messages API and that this API is compatible with Claude clients, which covers the core of the story. The evidence is limited to two brief first-party mentions. Missing for 10: documented endpoint path and request/response details (streaming, tool use, feature coverage), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can call the server through an Anthropic-compatible messages endpoint

citations.quote: LocalAI supports the Anthropic Messages API, which is compatible with Claude clients.
LocalAI also supports the **Anthropic Messages API**, the **Open Responses API**, and more.
